title: The Printaura-Woocommerce WordPress plugin through 4.0.2 does not properly restrict access to the WooCommerce REST…
description: The Printaura-Woocommerce WordPress plugin versions through 4.0.2 improperly restrict access to the WooCommerce REST API. This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to access all WooCommerce REST routes, enabling them to read and modify sensitive store data such as customer orders, personal information, store and payment settings, and webhooks.
